items.exampleEn: The elevator is out of order, so we have to use the stairs.
items.exampleZh: 電梯故障了，所以我們得走樓梯。

items.exampleEn: Who paid the bill at the restaurant?
The strong wind made it hard to open my umbrella.
items.exampleZh: 強風讓我很難把傘打開。

items.exampleEn: My dad drinks a cup of strong coffee every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸每天早上喝一杯濃咖啡。

items.exampleEn: Please take a seat. Mr. Lin will be here in a minute.
She took a risk and cut her hair very short.
items.exampleZh: 她冒了個險，把頭髮剪得很短。

items.sentenceEn: The ticket machine is out of order again.

items.audioEn: We couldn't play tennis yesterday because of the strong wind.
items.audioZh: 因為強風，我們昨天沒辦法打網球。
items.questionZh: 他們昨天為什麼沒打網球？

items.sentenceEn: Let's take a seat near the window.
Excuse me, can we pay the bill now?
items.sentenceZh: 不好意思，我們現在可以結帳嗎？

items.stemEn: I need a cup of ____ to stay awake tonight.
items.stemZh: 我今晚需要一杯濃咖啡來保持清醒。

items.stemEn: The coffee machine has been ____ since Monday.
items.stemZh: 咖啡機從星期一就故障了。

items.passageEn: Last year, my uncle took a risk. He left his office job and opened a small cafe by the sea. At first, business was slow, and the strong wind from the sea often blew his signs away. But he did his best every day, and his strong coffee and warm smile slowly made the cafe popular. Now people often wait in line outside. Last week I visited him, and when I tried to pay the bill, he laughed and said, "Family drinks for free!"
items.passageZh: 去年，我叔叔冒了一個險。他辭掉辦公室的工作，在海邊開了一家小咖啡店。起初生意很冷清，海邊的強風還常把他的招牌吹走。但他每天都盡全力，他的濃咖啡和溫暖的笑容慢慢讓咖啡店紅了起來。現在常常有人在門外排隊。上週我去看他，我想付帳時，他笑著說：「家人喝咖啡不用錢！」

questions.questionZh: 作者想付帳時，叔叔怎麼回應？

referenceEn: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
You have to take a risk sometimes.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 take a risk、take risks 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 take a chance 等）也算對
「必須」可寫，例如 have to、must、need to 等

items.promptZh: 昨天吃完晚餐後，我哥哥付了帳。
referenceEn: After dinner yesterday, my brother paid the bill.
My brother paid the bill after dinner yesterday.
Yesterday my older brother paid the bill after we finished dinner.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 paid the bill 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 paid for dinner、paid for the meal 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 paid 等）
「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother、big brother 等
